text.p: Swiss insurer Winterthur said on Tuesday its global business unit, Winterthur International Division (WID) had opened an office in Sydney which would provide international commercial insurance to the Australian general insurance market.

"Our entry to the Australian market is a key component of the group's strategic advance into the Asia/Pacific region," said the newly appointed managing director of WID's Sydney office, Daniel Nikles.
Nikles said the globalisation of the insurance industry had fueled the need for commensurately global insurance services.
"We're already receiving a very favourable market response from major multinational industrial customers and their insurance brokers," Nikles said.
Nikles said WID would play a complementary role to Winterthur's 48 percent owned direct insurance business in Australia, HIH Winterthur Ltd.

"HIH Winterthur is clearly the Australian market leader in corporate insurance business. We are now, quite literally, offering the world to the Australian insurance market and vice versa," Nikles said.
